name: groupon-mcp
description: Groupon deals for Claude — search and browse local, goods, and travel deals, and add deals to your signed-in cart with confirmation

groupon_session_cookie.title: Groupon session cookie (optional)
groupon_session_cookie.description: Optional, and only for the cart tools. Leave blank to have the ContextMint Bridge browser extension pick up your signed-in groupon.com session. To set it here, paste the full Cookie request header from a signed-in www.groupon.com request. It authorizes changes to your Groupon cart, so treat it like a password.

tools.name: groupon_healthcheck
tools.description: Make one live request to Groupon and report whether deal reads work, with a failure kind (edge_blocked, http, timeout, transport, stale_persisted_query)

tools.name: groupon_search_deals
tools.description: Search or browse Groupon deals for a city (no sign-in needed)

tools.name: groupon_get_deal
tools.description: Get one Groupon deal's detail, including each option's id and price (no sign-in needed)

tools.name: groupon_list_categories
tools.description: List Groupon's category taxonomy (no sign-in needed)

tools.name: groupon_view_cart
tools.description: View the items in your signed-in Groupon cart

tools.name: groupon_purchase
tools.description: Add a deal option to your signed-in Groupon cart after you confirm, and return the checkout URL; you complete payment yourself

tools.name: groupon_clear_cart
tools.description: Remove every item from your signed-in Groupon cart after you confirm
